d: Internal atrium of the imperial palace. Throne to the right. Crossed by the magnificent intercolumnium view of Byzantium. Senators of the palace, and People flocking from several parts.
Irene on the one hand, Eudora on the other, both following Donzelle.
Antonina and Eutropio, from opposite ways.
Justinian and Guards.
Foretold.

Belisario appears on a magnificent chariot: his head is surrounded by a laurel crown, and a purple mantle is superimposed on his golden armor. Around the Duce are the Goths prisoners, among whom is Alamiro: the Veterans close the triumph.
Apartment in the Palace of Belisario. Irene and Eudora meeting from opposite parts.
Eutropius, Guards, Alamirus, Irene, Belisario.
Senatorial Hall. On the one hand many seats among which one higher for the Emperor. There is a small table, on which some papyri, the volume of the laws, and a sword. Senators.
Justinian and Senators.
Belisario between Guards, Eutropius on the opposite side, and sayings.
The above and Antonina followed by Irene and Alamiro.
Remote part of Byzantium, on one side entrance of the prisons. Many Veterans and some of the People, scattered throughout the scene in different groups.
Alamiro, Chorus.
Irene, Eudora, Donzelle and sayings.
Belisario, Eusebius, Guards and sayings. Belisario has a dark blindfold on his eyes.
In the end the very high yokes of the Emo. The front is full of trees and rocks. Belisario without blindfold and Irene both barely advancing, as people troubled by long journey.
Alani and Bulgari.
Belisario and Irene appear on the edge of the anthem and sayings.
Justinian's tent, which opens in the middle, lets you see in the last distance the summits of the Emo. Justinian and Guards.
Antonina, that's it.
Irene surrounded by the Shepherds of the Emo and the Imperial Guards, and sayings.
Alessi and sayings.
Accompanied by gloomy music Belisario is conducted on the shields of the Veterans, Guards and sayings.
